rounds.story: Itiye lisusela egameni lesiShayina elithi te. Isiphuzo lesi sasabalala ngeendlela zokuthengiselana.
Ushukela uvela egameni lesiArabhu elithi sukkar. Lafika lapha lihlobene nokuthengiswa kwezinto ezimnandi.
Ikhofi ixhunyaniswa negama lesiArabhu elithi qahwa. Namhlanjesi sibiza ngalo iphuzo elivusako.
Itamati lilandela igama lesiNahuatli elithi tomatl. Isithelo lesi safika ngeendlela zokulima nokupheka.
Ijudo lafika nalo mdlalo wokulwisana waseJapani. Igama litjho indlela ethambileko yokuphosa nokuzivikela.
Ikarati yigama lomdlalo waseJapani wokuzivikela ngezandla neenyawo. Ligcine umsindo wakhona wasekuqaleni.
Imakaroni livela esiNtaliyani. Libizwa kanye nokudla okwenziwe ngofulawa okubiliswako.
Iyogathi lisusela esiTurki. Kukhulunywa ngobisi obuvutshelisiweko obudliwa loba buphuzwe.
Ingilazi yangena ivela esiDatjhi. Namhlanjesi sisitjenziswa ekubizeni isitja sokusela esicacileko.
Ibhodlela livela esiDatjhi. Sibiza ngalo isiqukathi sengwevu, amanzi, loba iziphuzo.
Ibhulukwe lihlobene nelesiDatjhi broek. EsiNdebele laba ligama lezambatho zemilenze emibili.
Itafula lafika livela esiDatjhi tafel. Sibiza ifenitjha yokubeka ukudla noma ukusebenza.
